title: Chansonia — a lyrics-synchronised player for «La lampe, le fleuve et les couleurs»
description:
Chansonia is a lyrics-synchronised music player for the album «La lampe, le fleuve et les couleurs», a six-track mini song-cycle by Je m'appelle Hương (Đỗ Thùy Hương), written between 7 and 13 August 2026. One codebase ships as a web app (GitHub Pages), an Android app and an iOS app, all built with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Capacitor.

Each track plays with its lyrics scrolling line by line, the sung line highlighted word by word; lyrics are grouped into named sections with a navigator, and every song also has a printable lyric sheet. The app carries an artist page, shuffle playback and a sleep timer. No account, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking.

Version 1.1.0 rebuilds the interface to match the songbook page of the author's academic homepage: the same clay palette (paper, terracotta, river teal), serif headings and paper cards, a dark variant that follows the device, and the clay artwork of the album bundled with the app so it stays legible offline.
